info.name: Organisation Catalogue - CRUD Tests
info.description:
Test suite for the Organisation Catalogue Service (/org/v1/*), using realistic Indian agricultural organisations as sample data.

Run folders top-to-bottom (Create -> Read -> Search -> Delete -> Import): Create requests save generated orgIds into collection variables consumed by Read/Delete. Set {{baseUrl}} if the app is not on http://localhost:8080.

Note: read/delete always return HTTP 200 ('not found' is reported in the body as message='Invalid Id'); create validation failures return HTTP 400.

request.description: Actuator health check - confirm the app is running on {{baseUrl}} before the suite.
